name: analytics
description: Open source, privacy-first web analytics. Lightweight, cookie-free Google Analytics alternative. Self-hosted or cloud.
whyFounders: Covers the traffic questions most founders actually ask, and because it sets no cookies it avoids the consent-banner work that a heavier analytics stack forces on you.
pros: No cookie banner needed for basic traffic reporting
Tracking script is a few kilobytes, so it does not slow pages down
The dashboard is one page, so there is almost nothing to learn
cons: Self-hosting runs both PostgreSQL and ClickHouse, which is more infrastructure than a single-database app
AGPL-3.0 licensed, which matters if you intend to modify and redistribute it
installHint: Docker Compose, using the setup in plausible/community-edition
